rationale: The Attic Motion sensor (SEN-M1) was offline with a battery level of 8%, and the base station log recorded "motion_attic battery level 8%". After the customer replaced the CR123A cell, the sensor came back online and resumed reporting events, confirming low battery as the cause. The earlier missed event last week is consistent with a gradually depleting battery (below 10% the device may miss events), and no other system-level fault was present (base station online, other devices online, firmware compatible).

repair_steps: Confirm the Attic Motion sensor is online and reporting events after battery replacement.
Advise the customer to use a fresh CR123A lithium battery and check the battery orientation.
Recommend monitoring the sensor for a few days to ensure stable operation.
If the sensor goes offline again or battery drains quickly, check for extreme temperatures in the attic or consider a higher-capacity battery.
Close the case as resolved at frontline.
